plan.title: Single-stage reverse auction with required and optional terms

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Enable eRFX project creation for the test company.
Allow the vendor to be added during event creation.
Configure the event as a single-stage reverse auction with rank-based bidding and whole-lot awarding.
Set the mandatory event title.
Select the reverse/buy auction template that defines the pricing sheet.
Add the requested product with quantity 10.
Set the first line item's delivery location.
Complete the remaining required pricing-sheet fields.

args.goal: On the buyer's single-stage event create screen, open Terms & Conditions, add the clauses "Payment within 45 days" and "Delivery within 7 days", set "Payment within 45 days" to Required, leave "Delivery within 7 days" as None, click Done, and stop with the saved terms configuration visible or confirmed

steps.note: Configure the event-wise terms with the required and none modes specified by the case.
Add one QA test vendor to the event.
Commit the immediate 30-minute event schedule.
Publish the configured auction.
Confirm the event reached a published project page.
Open the invited vendor's supplier portal in a separate session.
Open this event's pricing round in the vendor portal.
Confirm the required clause is shown to the vendor.
Confirm the optional/None clause is also shown to the vendor.
Accept the required clause.
Accept the second clause.
Quote 100 for the line and submit after accepting both clauses.
Verify that the vendor bid was submitted successfully.
